source: as un juego donde eres tu una persona que vive en Israel para escapar a estados unidos con barcos misiones incluso materiales para construir vas a Egipto y pasas por Marruecos para ir nadando en un bote para llegar a tu destino después de eso tienes que tener una visa para después ser nunca encontrado 🇮🇱🇸🇦🇲🇦 destino 🇺🇸 !!

image_prompt.text: A harbour mouth or border crossing marking the definite move from one country to the next
The last stretch of open water opening onto the distant American shore
Departures that cannot be sailed back from, so a finished country stays finished
A board where the missions for the current leg of the journey are posted
a small Israeli harbour with boats tied up and building materials stacked on the quay
an Egyptian desert coastline with docks and piers
a rocky Moroccan shore with small fishing boats
open sea between the coastlines, crossed by boat
the United States shore as the final destination on the horizon

layout_placement.text: The objective board for the current leg of the journey
Boat-building materials to gather along each coast before the next crossing

notes: Each country is treated as a separate map (P4); the prompt lists four distinct places that cannot sit on one surface at this scale.
The visa and never being found are the stated ending and have no field in this handoff.
The prompt names Israel, Egypt, Morocco and the United States and also flags Saudi Arabia; the route order is not fully coherent and was taken as written.

open_questions.ask: What are the missions on each leg - gathering materials, avoiding patrols, something else?
Is each country a full explorable coast, or one harbour scene per chapter?

theme: Modern real-world coastal - Mediterranean and North African harbours

coverage_missing.ask: What ends the game - arriving in the US, or getting the visa afterwards?
Should the countries be separate maps, or one continuous coastline you sail along?

answers.ask: What are the missions on each leg - gathering materials, avoiding patrols, something else?
answers.answer: Las misiones son reunir materiales para construir o mejorar el bote y completar cada tramo del viaje evitando patrullas; no hace falta añadir otras mecánicas.

answers.ask: Is each country a full explorable coast, or one harbour scene per chapter?
answers.answer: Haz un escenario de puerto pequeño por capítulo, no costas completas explorables, para que el viaje sea claro y jugable.
